neighbors.name: 50 Years

neighbors.name: Bor

neighbors.short_description: You only have one week to befriend the one who lives on the other side of the screen. He’s waiting for you, remembers all your visits, and even notices how long you’re gone. Play mini-games, listen to his thoughts, and simply watch how the world around you changes.

neighbors.name: Life ed
neighbors.short_description: Life ed it's not just a game, it's an unique experience.

neighbors.name: YOMOTSU

neighbors.name: Subway: 0% Escape

neighbors.name: Aeris&Zack

neighbors.short_description: Fly at high speed! Escape from the darkness that haunts you. Absorb as many light orbs as you can to unlock the different graphic stories. neighbors.short_description: You shouldn't be awake. After watching a late-night show about urban legends, paranoia takes hold: has your favorite toy, Mr. Zippy, come to life? Explore the house and survive this tense narrative-driven mascot horror experience featuring puzzle mechanics.

neighbors.name: Babette
neighbors.short_description: There's this old 90s virtual pet game at a yard sale. It's called 'Babette'. Now you can play with Babette the cat from the comfort of your bedroom. Just you and her! neighbors.name: Groovy Gig
neighbors.short_description: This is cozy game where you have arrived to planet Earth at the golden age of the 70's. Collect little trinkets, admire your trophies and nurture plants you have found. Relax and enjoy the music!

neighbors.name: The Week With Grugles 2
neighbors.short_description: Grugles Is Back! Make Sure He Doesn't Go Anywhere... Use the cameras and door to see if there are any intruders. But be careful, your power is limited!

neighbors.name: PuppetShow: Fatal Mistake Collector's Edition
neighbors.short_description: Can you stop a new monster brought to life before it’s too late?

neighbors.name: Cosmo Blue - A Space Odor Mystery

neighbors.name: PuppetShow: Return to Joyville Collector's Edition

neighbors.name: Muerte's Arena

neighbors.name: Thrice Entombed
neighbors.short_description: Your tomb has been raided and your treasure stolen, so it's time for revenge! Push blocks to crush enemies, solve puzzles, and level up. Recover your treasure to permanently restore your ancient strength. Inspired by the early 1980's arcade coin-op, Pengo.

neighbors.name: Grotto
neighbors.short_description: Grotto is a mystical, narrative-focused experience. You are the Soothsayer. The one capable of talking with the stars and unveiling their messages. In a time of turmoil, the tribe of the valley turn to your powers of divination and come to you for guidance.

neighbors.name: Horizon of Horus
neighbors.short_description: Embark on a thrilling journey through the mesmerizing landscapes of Ancient Egypt in "Horizon of Horus" – a Virtual Reality action-tower defense game. neighbors.name: Green Game: TimeSwapper
neighbors.short_description: It’s a challenging 2D arcade game where you are a master of time. Set it to past, present or future to control various mechanisms, and make sure that a mechanical bird will safely reach the end of the level. Prepare to die a lot – you will be sliced, squashed and crushed.

neighbors.name: Blake and Mortimer: The Curse of the Thirty Denarii

neighbors.name: VR Treasure Raider

neighbors.name: Birds of Impalatism
neighbors.short_description: Infiltrate a vaporwave mall run by a capatalist cult as a undercover agent. Trip out and shoot ghosts in puzzle levels. Uncover the truth of the Birds of Impalatism, and take down its leader.

parent_games.name: Is This Seat Taken?

neighbors.name: Panzer Elite Action Gold Edition
neighbors.short_description: The Gold Edition contains both Panzer Elite Action - Fields of Glory and its Dunes Of War expansion!

neighbors.name: Stupid Tankers

neighbors.name: HVS: Hitler VS Stalin - Battle Of Moscow

neighbors.name: Take Notes

neighbors.short_description: Dr. Trolley's Problem brings the classic philosophical quandaries of the Trolley Problem to life and asks you to make life or death decisions on the fly. Compare your decisions to others! Explore your moral fiber in ways you never imagined (or asked for)!

neighbors.name: Odd Happenings at the White House

Young journalist Thomas wants to write a newspaper article about the psychatric asylum in the small town Fuchsberg. Not knowing yet that he will be going on a great adventure leading to the greatest article of his life.

neighbors.name: Super Drift Blade
neighbors.short_description: Most of your actions have been taken away. In each time loop, slide the mouse to kill monsters, crack the puzzles locked by knowledge, and explore the hidden paths! Go deeper in a limited time and discover the truth of the world.

neighbors.short_description: Memoria is a classic memory matching game designed for Windows 3.1. Players are presented with a grid of face-down tiles, each holding a pictogram. The Objective is to find all matching pairs by flipping two tiles at a time.

neighbors.short_description: Waves of drunk NPCs are determined to reach their cars and drive home. Team up with friends, cause controlled chaos, and stop them before it’s too late.

neighbors.name: Drunken way to Home
neighbors.short_description: You've drunk too much... Let's go home while being aware of the dangerous around you! Drunken movements are fully simulated with physical calculation. Enjoy your drunkenness :)

neighbors.name: Flashback
neighbors.short_description: Flashback is a strategy game oriented to your choices. You will play the role of a deliveryman and live in a turbulent city for a month. You will meet various characters and experience events, and those characters' fates will cross and they will usher in their own futures based on your choices.

neighbors.name: Memoria Altera
neighbors.short_description: Wake up in a dark, futuristic lab with no memories of who you are or why you're there. Explore the lab with your fellow amnesiac Lenny as you complete puzzles to unlock more of the facility and regain more memories of your past. Will you like who you turn out to be?

neighbors.name: Drunk ride
neighbors.short_description: DRUNK RIDE is a fun motorcycle racing arcade game with a top view, with its bright and colorful world. You have to go on your iron horse to meet the speed and drive ...

neighbors.short_description: Escape Sequence is a synthwave highway racer where the traffic is a song and the wild drivers play it with you. neighbors.name: Elves Adventure
neighbors.short_description: Fate of the hero is in our hands, he is a stranger on new planet. He had occasion to return, but finally he stays and decides to help local people.

neighbors.name: Feed The Beast
neighbors.short_description: Make The Beast eat all the other players, that's the point of the game. But also! You have many characters to chose from, all of which have their unique abilities that can aid you with fighting your opponents.

neighbors.name: Squid Fighter
neighbors.short_description: This is a single/multiplayer swording shooting and fighting arena. You and your friends are invited to take participate in. neighbors.name: The Survival Show
neighbors.short_description: Survive the deadliest future game show in The Survival Show! Jump over razor-sharp lasers, dodge killer robots, and hurl live bombs before the clock runs out. Test your reflexes in a top-down arena, entertain the crowd, and claim the billionaire grand prize!

neighbors.name: QUIZ BREAKER
neighbors.short_description: Race to answer, then expose the contestant who knew the answers all along. QUIZ BREAKER combines four-choice buzzer quizzes, deduction and voting across three games. Play in friend rooms or join online alone with bot fill. Japanese-language gameplay.

neighbors.name: Cloudlypse
neighbors.short_description: A lone resistance hero fights forever on your taskbar. Corrupted machines mutate and evolve via genetic algorithms — no two swarms are alike. Catalog every threat, upgrade your hero, and survive an infinite apocalypse that never leaves your screen.

neighbors.name: Pull Stay
neighbors.short_description: Pull Stay is a wacky Beat 'em up game with Tower Defense mechanics. Use your fists or set crazy traps to repel enemies from rushing into your house! As a guardian robot, defend your buddy Susumu who has been a shut-in for years!

neighbors.name: Мистер Вселенная
neighbors.short_description: In this game you have to go through a difficult path - from a mere mortal to Mr. Universe, the legend of sports and cinema, whose list is achievements updated in real time.

neighbors.short_description: A grim dark narrative-driven RPG where your choices shape your future. Build wealth, influence and reputation in a city that never stops moving.

neighbors.name: Monari Station
neighbors.short_description: An ordinary commute becomes a moral crucible in Monari Station, a short psychological horror visual novel. Navigate an extreme situation, make value-defining choices... Discover what lingers after the train moves on...

neighbors.name: A-Train 9 V5.0 : Japan Train Simulator Ultimate Edition
neighbors.short_description: Build railroads. Construct your city. Master transport economics. A-Train 9 V5.0 Ultimate Edition is a realistic railroad management and urban development sandbox where every choice – from track layout to industry logistics – affects the prosperity of your metropolis.

neighbors.name: Transcendence
neighbors.short_description: This is a story about a small robot. As the first generation of commercial intelligent robot, it once served a brain neuroscientist. The machine was abandoned and cleared. Many years later, the robot in the garbage was awakened by unknown signals. It embarked on the road of finding who he is.

neighbors.name: Brno Transit
neighbors.short_description: A short narrative-driven psychological horror game about a trainee metro driver trapped in the dampest subway east of anything that matters.

neighbors.name: Skid Cities
neighbors.short_description: A Cyberpunk City Building Game. Define the city of a twisted, dark, utopian, or dystopian future. Build it in the sky, underground, on the ground. Navigate evil corporations, the Yakuza, android revolts, and unrest. Or embrace them - your choice.

neighbors.short_description: Step into a surreal city of the old future. Explore environments shaped by the soul of early 2000s design. Slow down inside a world built to be remembered.

neighbors.short_description: Play the role of the station master at a railway station in rural Japan and cope with the ever-increasing flow of passengers in this RPG management simulation! Use the station's funds to upgrade the station and design it to your liking!

neighbors.name: Up & Over
neighbors.short_description: Carry a parcel through a world above the clouds. Climb stairways, rooftops and moving crossings, explore three optional worlds behind ordinary doors, then return to the ascent. A full fall ends your attempt. Current game interface and story subtitles: Korean.

neighbors.name: The Dangerous Viewer | 위험한 시청자
neighbors.short_description: This is a first-person psychological horror game. As a new content creator, you move to an apartment on the outskirts of 2010s Seoul. As you make videos, disturbing messages and strange events follow. Behind simple content, dark shadows begin to move, quietly creeping into your life unnoticed.

parent_games.name: Holodance

neighbors.name: Buttons Up! 2
neighbors.short_description: Hoard Buttons and keep them safe from stealing gnomes. Get those Buttons Up by crafting buildings, trading with merchants and by travelling to weird biomes for rare resources. Unlock new skills with prestige points and become the button master in this chill survival incremental game.

neighbors.name: Spears of a Heart: Elusive Rhythms
neighbors.short_description: Start a new life and explore the mysterious island. Meet the people and unleash their secrets while you enjoy tons of rhythm mini-games. Dig the musical dungeons, sing at the karaoke, or synchronize monsters to get crafting resources!

neighbors.name: A Journey Rediscovered - Intro Version
neighbors.short_description: A VR-PC adventure rhythm game where you're travelling towards immortal life!

neighbors.name: Fuwa! Fuwa! Omurice Simulator Roguelite
neighbors.short_description: A tiny omurice diner. The stormy seas of the world economy. Business-Sim Roguelite × Rhythm. Craft your own build — strategy, cash flow, resource management — and survive raging capitalism without missing a beat!

neighbors.name: VR Travelling in 18th-19th Century Europe
neighbors.short_description: Our excursion game contains multiple sub-games and the three additional games of bow and arrow hunting, wooden fork fishing, and snake eating.

neighbors.name: Steal A Coffin
neighbors.short_description: Steal coffins, collect rare monsters, and turn their income into speed. Train on your treadmill to reach distant biomes and haul back better loot. Upgrade your gear and occasionally steal a coffin right out of another player's hands.

neighbors.name: Island Market Simulator
neighbors.short_description: Team up with your friends and build a thriving trade empire in this CO-OP strategy and economy simulation set on a lively island. Begin with a small market, share tasks, manage production chains, raise livestock, and dominate the economy together through changing seasons and dynamic festivals!

neighbors.name: SOUNDART
neighbors.short_description: Become one with sound and beauty... Pound, swing, and thrust away! A revolution in VR rhythm games! The automatically generated "scores" are literally infinite... Make - no, BECOME art, together with your favorite music! Show off your skills live as you play and get the audience rocking!

neighbors.name: Illegal Plantation
neighbors.short_description: It’s time to leave it all behind and do a dance with the law. Build your own illegal plantation, cultivate your weed, water the plants, maintain good air temperature and good lighting. Deliver your goods or hire local dealers for it. Get rid of the competition and build your own monopoly.

neighbors.name: VR Fantasy Island
neighbors.short_description: This is an early stage for the game VR Fantasy Island. We are trying out a concept to see if people would be interested in playing a game like this in VR.

neighbors.name: Music Movement
neighbors.short_description: A room-scale VR rhythm game that will have you moving and grooving all around with a simple premise: be in the right place at the right time with your hands as you navigate procedurally generated choreography.

neighbors.name: Music Parkour
neighbors.short_description: Smash, dodge, and crouch to the beat in this VR rhythm game. Unlock new environments like a desert, cave, or space station. Too easy? Crank up the difficulty or build your own levels with the map editor. Are you streaming? Let your chat trigger in-game events live and turn every run into chaos.

parent_games.name: Dünnes Eis - Das Spiel zum Song
parent_games.short_description: Dünnes Eis is a point-and-click short story by award-winning game designer Jan “Poki” Baumann, who has won numerous awards for games such as the Deponia series. Since 2021, Poki has dedicated himself to his music and band Baumann Bergmann Pokinsson.

parent_games.name: 1453: Fall of Constantinople
parent_games.short_description: Venice, 1500. Anna Notaras takes down four testimonies of the fall of Constantinople: a janissary, a baker's daughter, an engineer and a noble, each living the same 53 days of the siege. What one witness does changes what the others can do. An illustrated, choice-driven historical novel.

parent_games.name: Sophie in the Tangled World
parent_games.short_description: Solve puzzles in bewitching 19th-century Paris, where rooms loop and logic twists.

parent_games.name: Simulacro
parent_games.short_description: In this first-person philosophical journey, Poísis, an enthusiastic art student, explores a mysterious island in Greece. As she solves the local puzzles, she uncovers traces of its ancient inhabitants, leading her to question her own reality.

parent_games.name: Surradia: An Art Retrospective
parent_games.short_description: Unravel the mystery of three magical artists who went missing during World War II in this challenging, story-rich deduction game. Explore artworks, letters, photographs, and interviews to answer the question: What really happened to the Surradistes?

parent_games.name: Frostory
parent_games.short_description: You will explore a mysterious world with the little fairy, Sir Leonardo. An adventure awaits where you'll meet companions, fight wicked enemies, and uncover the secrets of a world in crisis. The end of the story is in your hands.

neighbors.name: Dünnes Eis - Das Spiel zum Song
neighbors.short_description: Dünnes Eis is a point-and-click short story by award-winning game designer Jan “Poki” Baumann, who has won numerous awards for games such as the Deponia series. Since 2021, Poki has dedicated himself to his music and band Baumann Bergmann Pokinsson.

neighbors.name: The Last Days of Reason
neighbors.short_description: A mini-adventure by Poki (known for Dünnes Eis, Deponia, Edna Breaks Out) that takes you back to the time of Aristotle and shortly before the end of Attic democracy. You play Nikki, who wants to be the first woman to be accepted at the Lyceum.

neighbors.name: 四魂-X Shikon-X Astro Defense Fortress
neighbors.short_description: Shikon-X is an intergalactic point and click adventure without any actual pointing or clicking! Set out on an epic quest to unravel the mysteries behind the war against humanity. Even when pitted against a cosmic threat, there’s always time for a bit of pinball.

neighbors.name: Pitstop in Purgatory
neighbors.short_description: Astrid wakes up in Purgatory and has to make peace with her death. Only problem is... she doesn't remember anything! Point and click your way through adventure-based gameplay mixed with visual novel storytelling, and solve the mystery of our heroine's untimely demise.

neighbors.name: James Peris 2: La fuente de la eterna embriaguez Uncut and Uncensored
neighbors.short_description: The long awaited new adventure by James Peris, after No License, No Control, Much more of everything! A point-and-click adventure with adult humor and a touch of hooliganism. Totally open gameplay and non-linear puzzles.

neighbors.name: Hei
neighbors.short_description: Help Hei to find their path to the sacred tree! A point-and-click adventure game with lots of puzzles and a unique artistic style.

neighbors.name: Sceal: An Irish Folklore Adventure
neighbors.short_description: The spirit of a little girl wanders the pages of a magical story book, searching for her lost memories, painting the world around her as she uncovers the fragments of her forgotten life.

neighbors.name: Eselmir and the five magical gifts
neighbors.short_description: Eselmir and the five magical gifts is a 2D point and click adventure game inspired by the old classics of the genre. It tells the story of Eselmir and his journey to find the five magical lost gifts of King Theoson, leading the player to explore a charming imaginary world.

neighbors.name: Thank You 4 Playing
neighbors.short_description: Gather information on social media in-game to take down every last boss in this deduction-based puzzle adventure game inspired by Return of the Obra Dinn. It's release day for the latest entry in a legendary action game series, and you need to beat it. Fun is secondary, victory is all.

neighbors.name: Jordi & Oslo: The Lost Tail
neighbors.short_description: Jordi & Oslo and the Lost Tail is a humorous point and click adventure game. Explore beautiful watercolour- painted locations, interact with quirky characters, and solve witty puzzles to help Jordi and Sigrid investigate the disappearance of their missing friend Oslo.

neighbors.name: 旧手表 - Old Watch
neighbors.short_description: This is an Visual Novel game. It's a story about time leap.

neighbors.name: Over the Alps
neighbors.short_description: A choices-matter spy thriller told through interactive postcards. Play a secret agent racing across 1930s Switzerland, sending coded reports to your handler. Charm, deceive or strong-arm your way through a Hitchcockian tale where every choice shapes the story.

neighbors.name: Silence, Exile, and Cunning
neighbors.short_description: A modern take on the classic adventure formula: explore, converse, and solve puzzles. Play as the young Irish writer James Joyce and his partner Nora Barnacle during their 1904 Mediterranean exile, in a port city where everyone seems to want something, and your small choices refuse to stay small.

neighbors.name: James Peris 2: The fountain of eternal drunkenness

neighbors.name: ASMR Toy VR

neighbors.short_description: "DreamVision Studio" is a Studio/World maker for content creators in real time that uses the webcam to generate an avatar that can interact with the customizable world. Its the definitive content creation playground that can be used as a tool.

neighbors.name: My Way VR
neighbors.short_description: A 360 degree video player that enables you to watch videos from all over the world. It detects geographical location of the video, so you can choose the place you want to visit.

neighbors.name: FreeDraw
neighbors.short_description: This game is an app that allows you to draw 3D pictures using brush tools in the virtual reality world.

neighbors.name: Head Tracker
neighbors.short_description: Control games using only your head movements. This innovative virtual joystick application tracks your head using a webcam or external camera, allowing you to control in-game cameras with ease.
